Two separate road accidents result in multiple deaths

Two separate road accidents involving motorcycles have been reported in different parts of India. In Darbhanga, a collision between two motorcycles resulted in the death of one teenager and serious injury to another, whose identity remains unknown. In Panchkula, two young men on a motorcycle died after being hit by a Thar vehicle, with the driver and vehicle reportedly fleeing the scene but captured on CCTV.
